description: Ministry of Water Supply - Land required for the Construction of Dolahena Water Storage Tank, Under New Kalawana Water Supply Project
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for public infrastructure projects (water storage tanks and treatment plants). It involves the acquisition of servitude rights and immobile properties over specific land parcels described in detailed schedules, including boundaries, extents, and claimant information. While a government minister is named and exercises powers under a specific act, the core subject matter is land acquisition and property rights, making it a Land Gazette.
